messages:
Priya N.: Quick heads-up — aiming for a quiet deploy tomorrow 12:30 PT (canary -> gradual). I'm primary owner for the window. Can folks confirm rollback/runbook readiness?

Priya N.: Rollback criteria I'm proposing: error spike >1% sustained for 2m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3m, or any customer-facing regressions reported. If hit, we abort and roll back.

Priya N.: Rollback steps (short):
```
1) Abort from Redwood Console (Deploys > active > Abort)
2) Flip feature flag: feature-service:llm-routing -> OFF (Dave)
3) Promote previous model version or revert task group (Mike)
4) Confirm KV cache invalidation + clear edge cache if needed
5) Run smoke tests and confirm healthy before reattempt
```

Mike R.: Ack. I'll monitor canary logs & synthetic checks. I have a scripted smoke runner and a quick replay for the last 1h of traffic ready to run if needed.

Dave L.: Ack. I'll own the feature-flag flip and the rollback toggle. I put the flag action in the runbook and prepped the playbook snippet.

Jen (SRE): Adding: I set alert thresholds on the canary dashboard: 5xx > 0.5% alert page after 1m, major latency alert on p95 > 1.8x baseline. I also enabled trace sampling for the canary group.

Mike R.: Suggestion for go/no-go: require 3 minutes with no new 5xx, p95 within 20% of baseline, and synthetic replay success. If any manual report from QA or one of us sees a regression -> abort.

Priya N.: Sounds good. I'll post a go/no-go message 15m before window and again at T-2m. Can everyone be online at T-0 to confirm?

Dave L.: I'll be oncall during the window. Will have the flag toggle ready in the UI and via CLI (`rbctl feature off llm-routing`).

Mike R.: I'll share the smoke runner command here at T-5: `./smoke_run.sh --canary --timeout 60` and tail logs: `tail -f /var/log/canary/*.log`

Jen (SRE): I'll watch alerts and own paging if thresholds fire. If I page, assume rollback unless someone calls out different.

Priya N.: One more: if we hit a degrad on a specific downstream (embed-store), we may do a targeted rollback of that change and keep rollout paused. Otherwise full rollback.

Priya N.: Thanks team. I'll pin this thread and add the runbook link. Ping me with any last-minute concerns. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job 12:30:10 PT (will post status updates).
